content:
**Responders Secret Service Underarmor** is an Underarmor in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Appalachia Under Siege* season.

Can be modified with Secret Service Underarmor Linings. Crafting requires having learned Plan: Secret Service Underarmor.

Crafting of the item can be unlocked as a reward during *Appalachia Under Siege*. 

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Ballistic Fiber (7) Circuitry (9) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:****Cost:**30 | | Responders Secret Service Underarmor (1) | 

The item can only be crafted by the player.
